page.overview:
Who is Aeldene Stonebridge?

Aeldene Stonebridge is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She has a crooked nose that was said to have been gotten from fighting with her fists as a girl.

Aeldene is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler. Siuan describes her as "no more than middling" in strength.

She is from the Mountains of Mist in Andor.
